description: FROZEN IN718 TEST SET (25 cases) for the two-alloy self-improvement loop. Held out: never trained on, and excluded from the acquisition candidate lattice by construction. Solved in the ds86529 anchor-box domain (900 x 600 x 450 um + 100 um gas, 10 um cells, 90x60x55) so it is directly evaluable by the Ti64 steady base model 86651 (workchain 86551) -- the IN718 validation campaign used 900x400x300+100, whose solves are NOT evaluable by that model (domain-extent mismatch silently scores gas the model never saw). Contents: the 7 NIST AM-Bench mds2-2718 conditions verbatim (P 245-325 W, V 0.80-1.20 m/s, spot DIAMETER 49/67/82 um -> r0 24.5/33.5/41.0 um) so the surrogate can be scored against measured depth/width, plus an 18-point LHS over (H, V, r0) in an EXPANDED box. The box is expanded because the experimental anchors lie OUTSIDE the Ti64 anchor box on two axes: P 245-325 vs 90-235 W and r0 24.5-41.0 vs 42-65 um, both disjoint. Cases are labelled by regime in design.csv: 11 OVERLAP (H <= 21.7, where ds86529 has Ti64 neighbours and alloy is the only thing changing) and 14 EXTRAPOLATION (above the Ti64 H ceiling, where a failure cannot be attributed to the alloy rather than to H-extrapolation). Score the two separately; do not pool them. Recipe is the standing post-calibration one: per-material Fresnel, recoil_model 2, void_vapor_pressure_pa 101325, IN718's own vapor_pressure_b 13.958762 (not Ti64's 16.077291), no plume, clean timing (turn_off_at_end true, finish = track/V rounded up onto a 1 ns grid). Beam resolution runs 2.30-6.36 cells per radius; the 2.45 end matches the campaign's own pre-registered blind test rep4_in718_s049.
